title: Victron Cerbo GX Telemetry Battery State of Charge Leaderboard
dataSources: Victron telemetry (`victron:telemetry`), iOverlander place logs (`ioverlander:place`), Garmin inReach messages (`inreach:message`), and Mopeka propane readings (`mopeka:tank`).
app: Victron Cerbo GX telemetry, iOverlander place exports, Garmin inReach check-ins, and Mopeka propane sensors streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=victron:telemetry battery_soc_pct=*
| stats sum(battery_soc_pct) as total_value, avg(battery_soc_pct) as avg_value by system_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks system name values by total and average battery state of charge across Victron Cerbo GX telemetry events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `battery_soc_pct` values for each Victron Cerbo GX telemetry event and review total and average battery state of charge by system name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total battery state of charge.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which system name shows the biggest battery state of charge numbers in your Victron Cerbo GX telemetry data.
